# Ultramar.capital LLM Context

Canonical domain: https://ultramar.capital
Canonical sitemap: https://ultramar.capital/sitemap.xml
Human-readable sitemap: https://ultramar.capital/sitemap
Legal: https://ultramar.capital/legal
Compliance: https://ultramar.capital/compliance

## Platform

Ultramar.capital is the canonical public app for the Ultramar platform. It presents two product lines:

1. Ultramar Private Equities
2. Ultramar Arbitrage Hedge Fund

Capital is the umbrella layer and should not be described as a third public product.

## Routing Policy

- https://ultramar.capital serves the canonical app directly.
- https://www.ultramar.capital redirects once to https://ultramar.capital.
- Prelaunch subdomains, including capital.ultramar.capital, polymarket.ultramar.capital, and private-equities.ultramar.capital, are intentionally not restored, aliased, or redirected.
- API JSON endpoints, auth routes, controlled portfolio surfaces, data-room unlock actions, and allocation actions are not public SEO destinations.

## Product Summaries

Private Equities organizes tokenized private-market workflows across asset discovery, issuer rounds, oracle-backed operating data, eligible secondary transfer context, compliance boundaries, and investor portfolio visibility. Public pages explain product workflow and asset context. Production participation requires eligibility checks, issuer-specific documents, legal review, and transfer controls.

The Arbitrage Hedge Fund is Polymarket-first. It compares prediction-market prices with model or derivatives-implied probabilities, then exposes signal status, confidence, position exposure, dashboard context, sizing controls, liquidity controls, and model-drift risk. Lending markets and derivative-only strategies are research context until data quality, risk limits, and allocator language are complete enough to graduate.

## Research Pages

Polymarket arbitrage explainer:
https://ultramar.capital/research/polymarket-arbitrage-explainer
Explains why prediction-market prices can diverge from derivatives-implied probability models and why spreads need explicit comparison models and risk controls.

Tokenized private equity primer:
https://ultramar.capital/research/tokenized-private-equity-primer
Explains that tokenized private equity requires issuer onboarding, legal wrappers, eligibility, data, custody, and transfer controls before tokens are useful.

Issuer oracle memo:
https://ultramar.capital/research/issuer-oracle-operating-data
Explains why issuer operating data, solvency context, liquidity state, and data recency matter for private-market trust.

Event-market risk controls memo:
https://ultramar.capital/research/event-market-risk-controls
Explains sizing, liquidity, exposure, resolution, and model-drift controls for event-market arbitrage.

## Compliance And Non-Offer Boundaries

- Ultramar.capital pages are product and research surfaces.
- Public pages do not provide legal, tax, accounting, or investment advice.
- Public pages do not collect funds, provide subscription instructions, or create binding commitments.
- Private-market participation can require KYC, KYB where relevant, investor category checks, suitability checks, jurisdiction review, issuer documents, transfer restrictions, custody controls, and counsel approval.
- Projected returns, yields, timelines, market conditions, and operating milestones are illustrative unless finalized in controlled documents.
- Non-public financials, subscription instructions, funds-flow details, allocation decisions, and investor-only Q&A belong behind permissioned access.
